feature_policy: DATE-valued events are conservatively visible only from the next day's midnight; at reference-time midnight, feature dates must be strictly earlier than the reference date.
label_policy: Keep each parent's SQL DATE window (reference_date, reference_date + source offset]; its complete label is available at the day after the inclusive end date. Keep exact thresholds, types, roles and source SQL empty-set behavior.
sampling_policy: Per-parent deterministic hash ranking of real account/reference-time pairs; account already open and at least one historical transaction; card-holding wording additionally requires a historically visible card. Deduplicate bound SQL globally before labels; no outcome balancing or resampling.
head_training_policy: Train on support/train, select on support/validation, and keep original qa/test as the current main test. Revised support/test is reserved for separate final evaluation, never per-query adaptation.
test_support_policy: Final temporal evaluation instances only; not adaptation data. Existing qa/test remains the current experiment cohort.
